title: Green simultaneous quantification of levodopa, carbidopa, and benserazide in anti-Parkinson's tablets by ATR-FTIR spectroscopy combined with hurdle modelling and machine learning
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,26513-26525
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02243J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Manh Huy Nguyen, Thanh Dam Nguyen, Hong Anh Duong, Hung Viet Pham
A two-stage ATR-FTIR/hurdle ML workflow enabled green simultaneous analysis of levodopa, carbidopa, and benserazide in Parkinson's tablets, while calibration transfer improved prediction accuracy for commercial samples.
